Here's a breakdown of the costs and requirements for studying a master's in the Netherlands:

### Tuition Fees
- **Statutory tuition fee (EU/EEA students)**: €2,694 per year [Study in NL - Tuition fees](https://www.studyinnl.org/finances/tuition-fees)
- **Institutional tuition fee (non-EEA students)**: €12,000-30,000 per year [Study in NL - Tuition fees](https://www.studyinnl.org/finances/tuition-fees)

### Living Costs
- **Monthly living costs**: €1,250-1,500 per month [Study in NL - Costs of living](https://www.studyinnl.org/plan-your-stay)

### Visa Requirements
- **Proof of funds**: You need to show about €1,130 per month for 12 months (roughly €13,569) as available funds, on top of any unpaid tuition. This is money you must demonstrate you have; it is not paid to the university or an agent. [Dutch immigration service (IND) - income requirements for study](https://ind.nl/en/income-requirements-study)
- **Residence permit fee**: €286 (non-refundable government fee for the residence permit, usually paid to and handled by your university as your sponsor) [Dutch universities (IND-set fee)](https://ind.nl/en)

### Other Costs
- **Application / handling fee (some institutions)**: €75-100 (one-time fee charged by some institutions when you submit an application) [Study in NL - Tuition fees](https://www.studyinnl.org/finances/tuition-fees)
- **Health insurance**: €150-1,600 per year (international students need valid health insurance; a student policy can be relatively cheap; if you work alongside study you may be required to switch to Dutch public insurance, which costs more) [Study in NL - Plan your stay (insurance)](https://www.studyinnl.org/plan-your-stay)

### Important Notes
- Your university acts as your official sponsor for the visa application and usually submits the immigration application for you. The NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship) does not cover all tuition and living costs. It provides a one-time grant of €5,000, which is paid in the first year of study. This amount does not cover the full tuition fee, and you will need to fund the rest of the tuition and all living costs yourself. 

Here are the details:
- **Name:** NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship)
- **Value:** €5,000, paid once in the first year of study
- **Covers Full Tuition:** No
- **Eligibility:** 
  - Nationality outside the European Economic Area (EEA)
  - Applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's at a participating institution
  - Not previously studied in the Netherlands
- **Caveats:**
  - This is NOT a full scholarship: €5,000 is a one-time amount and does not renew.
  - It does not cover tuition on its own; you still need to fund the rest of tuition and all living costs.
  - You apply directly to the university, not to a paid agency. Application is free.

Sources:
- [Study in NL - NL Scholarship](https://www.studyinnl.org/finances/nl-scholarship)
